name: sortable
title: Sortable
description: The drag that reorders a list, a row or a grid, hosted by any list: the item lifts onto a raised plate on the surface spring and follows the hand, the others glide out of the way, a sunk recess shows where it lands, and it lands on the object spring. Keys lift, move and drop it with every step announced; Escape puts it back; a failed save glides back to the previous order. useSortable is the engine for Tree, Kanban, Table and uploads.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/sortable.md. SwiftUI: MetalSortable in the MetalUI Swift package.
